item.description:
EasySign 0.1.1 adds a simple first-run setup.

  • Choose your signatures folder, with permission help and Retry.
  • Optionally connect Mail for sender profiles.
  • Skip setup and reopen it from Help → Set Up EasySign.

This remains a preview release. Sender-name delivery, iCloud synchronization, and older macOS compatibility have known limitations. See the user guide before relying on profiles.

First public preview of EasySign for macOS.

  • Edit and preview custom HTML signatures for Apple Mail.
  • Verified backups, restore, protected headers, and file locking.
  • Sender profiles with new-message and reply actions.
  • Optional signed updates through Sparkle.

Requires macOS 14 or later. Universal Apple silicon and Intel build.

Preview limitations: sender-name delivery can be inconsistent; verify received From headers. iCloud signature synchronization and Intel runtime behavior need further testing.
